applies_to.launch: as the summary (the same session directory's events.jsonl)
applies_to.selection: the version the capture discovered with junie --version

executor: journal-ocsf-writer JunieSessionMapper (direct Java); one record at a time
identity: junie.session.identity.v1: no event names the session; the summary.json of the same directory does (companion identity). stepId is the agent's own step id (stream-local, identity basis 2); LLM calls carry no id
usage: junie.usage.unnamed_cost.v1: a usage entry's cost is a quantity whose unit the source does not name (kind 99 Other, no currency); the per-model costs of the recorded runs sum to completion.taskCostUsd, but a sum in one run does not name their unit

rules.owner: tool_operation.uid = stepId; reported status (COMPLETED Success, FAILED Failure, else none); a terminal's command, output and exitCode
unidentified (no call id); usage per modelUsage entry (scope 2, final) and unnamed-unit cost (kind 99, model_ref)
item_uid = stepId; one text block from agentEvent.result; reported_state = errorCode ("Submit")
completion.taskCostUsd as money (kind 1, USD), scope 99 Task

selector.event.agentEvent.kind: any other (status, directory, environment, tip, task name, context window, patch) or TaskStartedEvent

rules.owner: retained whole with the meaning the mapper states

rules.selector: a record that is not one JSON object

rules.owner: the record retained whole with the failure

rules.meaning: Task identity and agent progress state as reported; no terminal outcome is inferred from progress text.
rules.owner: Native taskId on task start, or agent.id on progress; no global agent identity inferred
